title: Upcoming marathons in Kochi
description: Upcoming full-marathon races in Kochi, with distances and source-checked planning details.
intro: This calendar includes upcoming events in Kochi that offer the full 42.195 km marathon; half marathons and shorter runs are covered in our running-events calendar. The list may be short when few races have been announced. Event details and registration may change; check the organizer before making plans.
